findings.summary: Owner reauthentication was added as a precondition of the shared 'Disconnect or block' operation, but the Block affordance and Block journey still invoke it with only a confirmation, so Block now either always fails or contradicts the operation contract.
findings.evidence: operation.connection.revoke preconditions: [Participant authority, Owner reauthentication]; affordance.ConnectionPanel.block trigger: 'Owner confirms Block', preconditions: [Contact is linked to an Account]; J.control.block/b2 action: 'Choose Block and confirm' -> b3 stepOperation operation.connection.revoke

findings.summary: Step d2 now includes reauthentication, but its branches cover only confirm and cancel, so there is no path for the new 'Reauthentication failure denies the disconnect' outcome.
findings.evidence: d2 action: 'Choose Disconnect, confirm and reauthenticate'; next: [{to: d3, when: confirm}, {to: e2, when: cancel}]; affordance failure: 'Reauthentication failure denies the disconnect'

findings.summary: The system step that performs the revoke still lists only the participant authority check and omits the newly required owner reauthentication check.
findings.evidence: d3 action: 'Participant authority checked; sharing revoked; pending deliveries cancelled' vs operation description 'Participant authority and owner reauthentication.'
